method:
Scorecard: do the research and the trades add value? Usage (from the valuation folder): python3 scoring/scorecard.py D

Writes scoring/scorecard.json for market date D and prints a short summary. Two parts:

forecasts  From scoring/live_scores.json (score_live.py is run first if that file is not for D). For 1-month and
           12-month forecasts separately: mean CRPS (log-price units, lower is better) of the options market alone
           (p_market), the agents alone after Platt scaling (p_llm_platt) and the published blend (p_final), and the
           agents-minus-market CRPS difference with a standard error clustered by forecast date (names forecast on the
           same date move together, so forecast dates are the independent units).

live_book  The real book rebuilt day by day from data/trades.json (the owner's fills) and data/book.json, from the
           close before the first fill to D. Stocks are marked at the daily close; cash (in the account and the outside
           cash in book.json external_cash) earns the 3M T-bill (../portfolio/data/tbill_3m_weekly.csv, notional,
           calendar days / 365); dividends (../portfolio/data/dividends.json) are credited on the ex-date. Outside money
           (book.json external_cash and lots bought outside the project, funding "external") enters as a cash flow at
           the start of the day it joined the book, valued at the prior close; returns are time-weighted (each day's
           return = value at close / (prior close value + flow at the open) - 1), so added money is not counted as return.
           Compared with:
             hold_first_book  the book at the close of the first fill day, never traded again; the same outside money
                              enters on the same days and is then held as is (cash stays cash, outside lots are kept).
                              Gap = value of every later add, trim, sale and deployment of new cash ("add_trim_value").
             hold_first_book_no_flows  the same first-day book with no outside money (pure buy-and-hold of day 1).
             spy              SPY close-to-close plus distributions reinvested on the ex-date (no adjusted closes in the
                              data; dividends.json supplies SPY distributions). Fully invested, so flows do not matter.
             equal_weight     equal weight in the names the real book holds; rebalanced to equal weight at the close on
                              any day the set of names changes and on the first trading day of each month, drifting
                              otherwise; holds T-bill cash while the book holds no stock. Fully invested otherwise.
           A few weeks of daily returns cannot separate skill from luck: the numbers say what happened, not whether it
           will happen again.

standard_model_trial  The standard model's 12-month target (weight 0, on trial since Kilian 2026-10-19) scored beside the
           blended target and the supervisor fair value: see scoring/std_model_log.py for the log and the method.
           Pending until the first targets logged (2026-10-13) mature.

1m.status: 1-month: 2 forecast dates (34 ladders) scored; agents minus market CRPS +0.0002 ± 0.0009 (agents worse); too few forecast dates to judge (20+ needed).

12m.status: First 12-month forecasts mature 2027-09-25; nothing scored yet.

live_book.spy_basis: price plus distributions reinvested on the ex-date (dividends.json); no adjusted closes in the data
live_book.dividends_missing_note: names not in dividends.json are treated as paying nothing
live_book.note: 22 trading days of returns cannot show skill: daily stock returns swing by about 1-2%, so a gap of a few percent over a few weeks is well within luck. rough_se treats days as independent; read the gaps as what happened, not as evidence, until there are many months. Cash earns the T-bill notionally in every account.

add_trim_value.meaning: real book minus the first-day book held unchanged with the same outside money added as cash/lots (time-weighted); it counts every later add, trim, sale and the pace of putting new cash to work.

standard_model_trial.weight: 0 in fair value and levels (trial, Kilian 2026-10-19)
standard_model_trial.outcome: first close on or after the forecast date + 1 year (the blended target horizon), split-adjusted to the forecast basis
standard_model_trial.status: Standard model trial (weight 0): pending. 243 on-time 12-month targets logged from 14 forecast dates since 2026-10-13 (26 names, 45 distinct research runs); first outcomes 2027-10-13. Scored then against the realised price beside the blended target and the supervisor fair value.
